The Field / Household notebook

The assumptions are part of the example.

Read the rules, the source claims and the limits of this constructed example.

Synthetic worked case · fictional participants A and B · no calibrated behavioral predictions

What this notebook can establish

This is an executable synthetic example with uncalibrated parameters. It calculates consequences of declared assumptions; it does not establish how actual households behave or adjudicate the tweet’s empirical predictions.

Values, reported satisfaction, material feasibility and the practical ability to renegotiate are distinct. No calculated willingness value stands in for consent, happiness or trust. Standing is unchanged by work, refusal, withdrawal or leaving.

Four orientations; four sets of tradeoffs.

Role-based specialization

A primarily provides income; B primarily manages the home. They value continuity, distinct responsibilities and an inherited account of family life.

How it could work

Both welcome their roles, the work is feasible, and each contribution is recognized. Exceptions can be understood as care within a continuing commitment.

How it could fail

The partners attach different meanings to the same roles, or an assigned responsibility exceeds the person's capacity while the label conceals that mismatch.

Equal sharing

Both pursue paid work and share domestic responsibility. They value reciprocity, participation and equal standing.

How it could work

They agree what equality means, include planning and coordination as work, and accept practical exceptions.

How it could fail

A task count looks equal while effort, responsibility or rest differs; alternatively, enforcing exact symmetry becomes an unwanted burden for both.

Capacity-based specialization

Tasks follow current skill, available time and preference rather than fixed identities. They value practicality and complementary strengths.

How it could work

The allocation fits present capacities, and either partner can acquire skills or request a different allocation.

How it could fail

The same person repeatedly absorbs work because they are already better at it; the arrangement protects present efficiency while leaving the other without practice or alternatives.

Alternating priorities

One partner's career, study or caregiving project receives priority for a defined period, with a later change of emphasis. They value shared projects and reciprocity across time.

How it could work

The initial sacrifice is welcome, resources suffice, and the later opportunity remains meaningful and feasible.

How it could fail

Future reciprocity is vague, the priority period continually extends, or the promised later opportunity disappears.

These arrangements can overlap. Equal standing does not require identical task shares. Specialization does not require unilateral authority. A and B’s sex does not select a role.

The rules, in readable form

  1. Carry a household through twelve periods

    At each opening, apply authored changes to values, capacity or demand. Period 5 introduces the selected change. Some experience patterns change again at period 9. Carry allocation, backlog, money and each person’s closing willingness into the next period.

  2. Separate a request from a successful revision

    Opening willingness determines whether a request is voiced and bounds review and task movement. A respectful hearing can occur without an acceptable proposal. Dismissive handling blocks the joint proposal. Unknown handling supplies no positive or negative request evidence.

  3. A signed agreement is followed by execution

    A passing revision supersedes the previous allocation. Each assignment covers its share of the current domestic task pool, including backlog. Capacity determines achievable work; the authored delivery fraction determines how much of that achievable work is done. Unfinished work remains visible.

    delivered domestic work = achievable domestic work × delivery fraction
next backlog = current domestic task pool − total domestic work delivered
next reserve = opening reserve + paid income − covered expenses

  4. Update willingness from directed evidence

    For observer willingness w and rate g or l:

    positive evidence: w′ = w + g × (1 − w)
negative evidence: w′ = w × (1 − l)
neutral or learning disabled: w′ = w

    The requester receives heard or dismissed evidence. Each person receives evidence about the other’s executed commitment. Capacity-only shortfall defaults to neutral; implementation-only shortfall may reduce willingness. Mixed attribution, unknown quality, empty obligations and superseded allocations have no automatic effect.

  5. Keep the feedback delayed and attributable

    Record response evidence, explicit outreach and delivery evidence in order. Closing willingness becomes available next period; it cannot change the current review retrospectively. An invitation and a hearing about the same interaction do not manufacture two hearing gains. No request is inferred from silence.

A limit is different from a refusal

Capacity-limited delivery and incomplete implementation are different accounting outcomes. Neither alone diagnoses intention or bad faith. The delivery fraction is an authored input; the model does not infer its cause. Higher income can coexist with an unfulfilled task commitment.

Explicit respectful outreach can support reopening from zero willingness. Changed practice does not erase earlier events, restore the former value automatically or establish forgiveness.

What symmetry does and does not establish

The local rules use participant-neutral labels. Swapping A and B is a useful test of hidden role assumptions. The retained audit found local exchange symmetry but 28 order-sensitive trajectories in the 100-case design. Whole-run exchange invariance is therefore not established: agenda order and ties can affect later history.

This boundary prevents a symmetric-looking interface from claiming a stronger fairness result than the arithmetic supports. No score ranks the worth of either participant.

The motivating statement, disassembled

The primary source is Noah Revoy’s post of 6 November 2026. Direct retrieval failed; the text and its quoted post were retrieved through FxTwitter that day. This is one mediated evidence family, without an immutable source snapshot. Later edits require checking the decomposition again. The quoted image is outside the case.

Population claims need specified measures, comparisons and time horizons. Simultaneous aggregate trends do not identify individual causal effects. Personal testimony does not supply the other spouse’s account. Prescriptions require normative arguments; an analogy between a business and a marriage requires a bridge.

Retained sources and executable rules

The source listings below preserve the model’s assumptions and derivation for inspection. They belong to one local synthetic evidence family, rather than independent observations of people.

        "steps": [

                "port": "number.calculate",

            "yield": [

            "data-door"
          ],
          [
            "at",
            "$button.attributes",
            "data-view"
          ],
          [
            "at",
            "$button.attributes",
            "data-layer"
          ]
        ]
      },
      {
        "port": "kernel.invoke",
        "args": {
          "query": [
            "concat",
            "activity.action.",
            "$action"
          ],
          "input": {
            "button": "$button",
            "value": "$value"
          }
        },
        "into": "result"
      },
      {
        "call": "activity.calculations"
      }
    ],
    "activity.input": [
      {
        "let": "input",
        "value": "$eventInput.matched"
      },
      {
        "let": "value",
        "value": "$input.value"
      },
      {
        "when": [
          "eq",
          [
            "at",
            "$input.attributes",
            "id"
          ],
          "lens-angle"
        ],
        "then": [
          {
            "port": "number.parse",
            "args": {
              "value": "$value"
            },
            "into": "angle"
          },
          {
            "port": "kernel.invoke",
            "args": {
              "query": "reader.model.calibration",
              "input": {
                "angle": "$angle"
              }
            },
            "into": "reading"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "multiply",
              "values": [
                "list",
                -1,
                "$angle"
              ]
            },
            "into": "rotation"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.attribute",
            "args": {
              "ref": "#lens-axis",
              "name": "transform",
              "value": [
                "concat",
                "rotate(",
                "$rotation",
                " 200 165)"
              ]
            },
            "into": "_"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.write",
            "args": {
              "ref": "#angle-value",
              "name": "textContent",
              "value": [
                "concat",
                "$angle",
                "°"
              ]
            },
            "into": "_"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.format",
            "args": {
              "value": "$reading",
              "digits": 2
            },
            "into": "reading"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.write",
            "args": {
              "ref": "#lens-value",
              "name": "textContent",
              "value": "$reading"
            },
            "into": "_"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.write",
            "args": {
              "ref": "#lens-caption",
              "name": "textContent",
              "value": [
                "if",
                [
                  "eq",
                  "$angle",
                  0
                ],
                "At this angle, two different points share one reading.",
                [
                  "if",
                  [
                    "eq",
                    "$angle",
                    90
                  ],
                  "The line now shows the full difference between the points.",
                  "Turning the line makes part of the difference visible."
                ]
              ]
            },
            "into": "_"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "when": [
          "eq",
          [
            "at",
            "$input.attributes",
            "data-world-input"
          ],
          "garden"
        ],
        "then": [
          {
            "call": "activity.garden"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "when": [
          "eq",
          [
            "at",
            "$input.attributes",
            "data-world-input"
          ],
          "weights"
        ],
        "then": [
          {
            "port": "kernel.invoke",
            "args": {
              "query": "reader.model.weights",
              "input": {
                "percent": "$value"
              }
            },
            "into": "scores"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.format",
            "args": {
              "value": "$scores.a",
              "digits": 2
            },
            "into": "scoreA"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.format",
            "args": {
              "value": "$scores.b",
              "digits": 2
            },
            "into": "scoreB"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.write",
            "args": {
              "ref": "#score-a",
              "name": "textContent",
              "value": "$scoreA"
            },
            "into": "_"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.write",
            "args": {
              "ref": "#score-b",
              "name": "textContent",
              "value": "$scoreB"
            },
            "into": "_"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.write",
            "args": {
              "ref": "#weight-label",
              "name": "textContent",
              "value": [
                "concat",
                "$value",
                "%"
              ]
            },
            "into": "_"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "greater",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$scores.a",
                "$scores.b"
              ]
            },
            "into": "preferA"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.write",
            "args": {
              "ref": ".world-result",
              "name": "textContent",
              "value": [
                "if",
                [
                  "eq",
                  "$scores.a",
                  "$scores.b"
                ],
                "The two plans have the same score with these priorities.",
                [
                  "concat",
                  "Option ",
                  [
                    "if",
                    "$preferA",
                    "A",
                    "B"
                  ],
                  " ranks higher under these declared weights. The plans’ speed and thoroughness scores have not changed."
                ]
              ]
            },
            "into": "_"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],

    "activity.garden": [
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "mode"
        },
        "into": "mode"
      },
      {
        "let": "mode",
        "value": [
          "or",
          "$mode",
          "budget"
        ]
      },
      {
        "port": "number.parse",
        "args": {
          "value": "$value"
        },
        "into": "value"

        "port": "kernel.invoke",

          "query": "reader.model.pairs",

          {
            "port": "number.parse",
            "args": {
              "value": [

            },

          },
          {
            "port": "browser.class",
            "args": {
              "ref": "$seed.ref",

                [

                  [

                    "$x",
                    "$y"
                  ]
                ]
              ]
            },
            "into": "_"

        ]
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",

      },
      {

          "value": [
            "concat",
            "Twenty-five nonnegative integer pairs. ",
            [
              "count",
              "$allowed"
            ],
            " satisfy ",
            [
              "if",
              [
                "eq",
                "$mode",
                "positive"
              ],
              "x times y no less than c squared",
              "x plus y no greater than the budget"
            ],
            "."
          ]
        },
        "into": "_"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {
          "ref": ".world-result",
          "name": "textContent",
          "value": [
            "concat",
            [
              "count",
              "$allowed"
            ],
            " of 25 represented pairs satisfy ",
            [
              "if",
              [
                "eq",
                "$mode",
                "positive"
              ],
              "the rule for these two linked quantities",
              "the shared-limit rule"
            ],
            "."
          ]
        },
        "into": "_"
      }
    ],
    "activity.action.gate": [
      {
        "let": "button",

    "activity.action.flip-bit": [
      {
        "let": "button",
        "value": "$eventInput.button"
      },
      {
        "let": "value",
        "value": "$eventInput.value"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "bits"
        },
        "into": "bits"
      },
      {
        "let": "bits",
        "value": [
          "or",
          "$bits",
          [
            "list",
            0,
            0,
            0
          ]
        ]
      },
      {
        "port": "number.parse",
        "args": {
          "value": "$value"
        },
        "into": "index"
      },
      {
        "fold": "$bits",
        "as": "bit",
        "accumulator": "position",
        "initial": 0,
        "steps": [],
        "yield": [
          "add",
          "$position",
          1
        ],
        "into": "ignored"
      },
      {
        "let": "bits",
        "value": [
          "map",
          [
            "range",
            3
          ],
          "n",
          [
            "if",
            [
              "eq",
              [
                "add",
                "$n",
                -1
              ],
              "$index"
            ],
            [
              "if",
              [
                "eq",
                [
                  "at",
                  "$bits",
                  "$index"
                ],
                0
              ],
              1,
              0
            ],
            [
              "at",
              "$bits",
              [
                "add",
                "$n",
                -1
              ]
            ]
          ]
        ]
      },
      {
        "port": "state.set",
        "args": {
          "key": "bits",
          "value": "$bits"
        },
        "into": "_"
      },
      {
        "call": "activity.code"
      }
    ],

        },
        "into": "buttons"
      },
      {
        "fold": "$buttons",
        "as": "bitButton",
        "accumulator": "index",
        "initial": 0,
        "steps": [
          {
            "let": "bit",
            "value": [
              "at",
              "$bits",
              "$index"
            ]
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.write",
            "args": {
              "ref": "$bitButton.ref",
              "name": "textContent",
              "value": "$bit"
            },
            "into": "_"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.attribute",
            "args": {
              "ref": "$bitButton.ref",
              "name": "aria-pressed",
              "value": [
                "eq",
                "$bit",
                1
              ]
            },
            "into": "_"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.attribute",
            "args": {
              "ref": "$bitButton.ref",
              "name": "aria-label",
              "value": [
                "concat",
                "Received bit ",
                [
                  "add",
                  "$index",
                  1
                ],
                ": ",
                [
                  "if",
                  [
                    "eq",
                    "$bit",
                    1
                  ],
                  "one",
                  "zero"
                ]
              ]
            },
            "into": "_"
          }
        ],
        "yield": [
          "add",
          "$index",
          1
        ],
        "into": "index"
      },
      {
        "port": "kernel.invoke",
        "args": {
          "query": "reader.model.decode",
          "input": {
            "bits": "$bits"
          }
        },
        "into": "decoded"
      },
      {
        "let": "changed",
        "value": [
          "count",
          [
            "filter",
            "$bits",
            "bit",
            [
              "not",
              [
                "eq",
                "$bit",
                "$original"
              ]
            ]
          ]
        ]
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {
          "ref": ".world-result",
          "name": "textContent",
          "value": [
            "concat",
            "Decoder returns ",
            "$decoded",
            ". ",
            "$changed",
            " changed ",
            [
              "if",
              [
                "eq",
                "$changed",
                1
              ],
              "bit",
              "bits"
            ],
            ". ",
            [
              "if",
              [
                "eq",
                "$decoded",
                "$original"
              ],
              "The original bit is recovered.",
              "This is outside the one-flip correction budget; the original bit is not recovered."
            ]
          ]
        },
        "into": "_"
      }
    ],
    "activity.action.rate": [

    "activity.action.scale": [
      {
        "let": "button",

        },
        "into": "_"

      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {

            [

            [

              [
                "count",
                "$cells"
              ],
              " ",
              [

                [

                  [

                  ],

    "activity.action.loop": [
      {
        "let": "button",
        "value": "$eventInput.button"
      },
      {
        "let": "value",
        "value": "$eventInput.value"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.set",
        "args": {
          "key": "loopRunning",
          "value": true
        },
        "into": "_"
      },
      {
        "port": "clock.read",
        "args": {},
        "into": "clock"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.set",
        "args": {
          "key": "loopStart",
          "value": "$clock.monotonic"
        },
        "into": "_"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {
          "ref": "[data-demo=\"loop\"]",
          "name": "disabled",
          "value": true
        },
        "into": "_"

      {
        "port": "browser.write",

        "port": "browser.attribute",
        "args": {
          "ref": "[data-demo=\"loop\"]",

        },

      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {

          "name": "textContent",
          "value": "Following the frame around the path…"
        },
        "into": "_"

        "port": "browser.frame",
        "args": {
          "query": "activity.loop.frame",
          "input": {}
        },
        "into": "_"
      }
    ],
    "activity.loop.frame": [
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "loopRunning"
        },
        "into": "loopRunning"
      },
      {
        "when": "$loopRunning",
        "then": [
          {
            "port": "state.get",
            "args": {
              "key": "motion"
            },
            "into": "motion"
          },
          {
            "port": "state.get",
            "args": {
              "key": "loopStart"
            },
            "into": "loopStart"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.environment",
            "args": {},
            "into": "environment"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "subtract",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$eventInput.time",
                "$loopStart"
              ]
            },
            "into": "elapsed"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "divide",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$elapsed",
                1800
              ]
            },
            "into": "elapsed"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "min",
              "values": [
                "list",
                1,
                "$elapsed"
              ]
            },
            "into": "t"
          },
          {
            "let": "t",
            "value": [
              "if",
              [
                "and",
                "$motion",
                [
                  "not",
                  "$environment.reduced"
                ]
              ],
              "$t",
              1
            ]
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "multiply",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$t",
                6.283185307179586
              ]
            },
            "into": "angle"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "sin",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$angle"
              ]
            },
            "into": "sine"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "cos",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$angle"
              ]
            },
            "into": "cosine"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "multiply",
              "values": [
                "list",
                150,
                "$sine"
              ]
            },
            "into": "x"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "add",
              "values": [
                "list",
                250,
                "$x"
              ]
            },
            "into": "x"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "multiply",
              "values": [
                "list",
                115,
                "$cosine"
              ]
            },
            "into": "y"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "subtract",
              "values": [
                "list",
                180,
                "$y"
              ]
            },
            "into": "y"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "multiply",
              "values": [
                "list",
                90,
                "$t"
              ]
            },
            "into": "rotation"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.attribute",
            "args": {
              "ref": "#return-frame",
              "name": "transform",
              "value": [
                "concat",
                "translate(",
                "$x",
                ",",
                "$y",
                ") rotate(",
                "$rotation",
                ")"
              ]
            },
            "into": "_"
          },
          {
            "when": [
              "not",
              [
                "eq",
                "$t",
                1
              ]
            ],
            "then": [
              {
                "port": "browser.frame",
                "args": {
                  "query": "activity.loop.frame",
                  "input": {}
                },
                "into": "_"
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "when": [
              "eq",
              "$t",
              1
            ],
            "then": [
              {
                "port": "state.set",
                "args": {
                  "key": "loopRunning",
                  "value": false
                },
                "into": "_"
              },
              {
                "port": "browser.write",
                "args": {
                  "ref": "[data-demo=\"loop\"]",
                  "name": "disabled",
                  "value": false
                },
                "into": "_"
              },
              {
                "port": "browser.write",
                "args": {
                  "ref": "[data-demo=\"loop-reset\"]",
                  "name": "disabled",
                  "value": false
                },
                "into": "_"
              },
              {
                "port": "browser.write",
                "args": {
                  "ref": "#loop-readout",
                  "name": "textContent",
                  "value": "Back at the start. The arrow now points a quarter-turn away."
                },
                "into": "_"
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ],

        },
        "into": "dialog"
      },
      {
        "when": [
          "eq",
          "$eventInput.event.target.ref.handle",
          "$dialog.ref.handle"
        ],
        "then": [
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "less",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$eventInput.event.clientX",
                "$dialog.rect.left"
              ]
            },
            "into": "left"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "greater",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$eventInput.event.clientX",
                "$dialog.rect.right"
              ]
            },
            "into": "right"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "less",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$eventInput.event.clientY",
                "$dialog.rect.top"
              ]
            },
            "into": "above"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "greater",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$eventInput.event.clientY",
                "$dialog.rect.bottom"
              ]
            },
            "into": "below"
          },
          {
            "when": [
              "or",
              "$left",
              "$right",
              "$above",
              "$below"
            ],
            "then": [
              {
                "port": "browser.dialog",
                "args": {
                  "ref": "#activity-source",
                  "open": false
                },
                "into": "_"
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ],

      {
        "port": "browser.environment",

      {
        "port": "browser.attribute",
        "args": {

            "$environment.reduced",

      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",

      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",

          },
          {

      },
      {

    "household.rebuild": [
      {
        "port": "state.get",

          "key": "hh-orientation"

      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-change"
        },
        "into": "change"

        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-profile"
        },

        "args": {

        },

      },

        "args": {
          "query": "household.sync",

        },

      }
    ],
    "household.sync": [
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-run"
        },
        "into": "run"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-scenario"
        },
        "into": "scenario"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-person"
        },
        "into": "person"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-phase"
        },
        "into": "phase"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-overrides"
        },
        "into": "overrides"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-orientation"
        },
        "into": "orientation"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-change"
        },
        "into": "change"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-profile"
        },
        "into": "profile"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-enabled"
        },
        "into": "enabled"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {
          "ref": "#hh-orientation",
          "name": "value",
          "value": "$orientation"
        },
        "into": "hp150"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {
          "ref": "#hh-change",
          "name": "value",
          "value": "$change"
        },
        "into": "hp151"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {
          "ref": "#hh-profile",
          "name": "value",
          "value": "$profile"
        },
        "into": "hp152"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {
          "ref": "#hh-person",
          "name": "value",
          "value": "$person"
        },
        "into": "hp153"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {
          "ref": "#hh-phase",
          "name": "value",
          "value": "$phase"
        },
        "into": "hp154"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.write",
        "args": {
          "ref": "#hh-enabled",
          "name": "checked",
          "value": "$enabled"
        },
        "into": "hp155"
      },
      {
        "let": "row",
        "value": [
          "at",
          "$run.history",
          [
            "if",
            [
              "eq",
              "$phase",
              "initial"
            ],
            0,
            4
          ]
        ]
      },
      {
        "let": "per",
        "value": [
          "at",
          "$row.assumptions",
          [
            "if",
            [
              "eq",
              "$person",
              "A"
            ],
            0,
            1
          ]
        ]
      },
      {
        "fold": "$data.household.controls",
        "as": "def",
        "accumulator": "unused",
        "initial": null,
        "steps": [
          {
            "let": "phaseKey",
            "value": [
              "if",
              [
                "eq",
                "$def.scope",
                "rate"
              ],
              "run",
              [
                "if",
                [
                  "eq",
                  "$def.scope",
                  "resource"
                ],
                "initial",
                "$phase"
              ]
            ]
          },
          {
            "let": "id",
            "value": [
              "concat",
              "$def.scope",
              "-",
              [
                "if",
                [
                  "eq",
                  "$def.scope",
                  "resource"
                ],
                "household",
                "$person"
              ],
              "-",
              "$phaseKey",
              "-",
              "$def.key"
            ]
          },
          {
            "let": "edit",
            "value": [
              "at",
              [
                "filter",
                "$overrides",
                "e",
                [
                  "eq",
                  "$e.id",
                  "$id"
                ]
              ],
              0
            ]
          },
          {
            "let": "base",
            "value": [
              "if",
              [
                "eq",
                "$def.scope",
                "person"
              ],
              [
                "if",
                [
                  "includes",
                  [
                    "list",
                    "capacity",
                    "willingness",
                    "wage"
                  ],
                  "$def.key"
                ],
                [
                  "at",
                  "$per",
                  "$def.key"
                ],
                [
                  "at",
                  "$per.values",
                  "$def.key"
                ]
              ],
              [
                "if",
                [
                  "eq",
                  "$def.scope",
                  "experience"
                ],
                [
                  "at",
                  [
                    "at",
                    "$row.experience",
                    "$person"
                  ],
                  "$def.key"
                ],
                [
                  "if",
                  [
                    "eq",
                    "$def.scope",
                    "rate"
                  ],
                  [
                    "at",
                    [
                      "at",
                      "$scenario.feedback",
                      "$person"
                    ],
                    "$def.key"
                  ],
                  [
                    "at",
                    "$scenario.material.initial",
                    "$def.key"
                  ]
                ]
              ]
            ]
          },
          {
            "let": "value",
            "value": [
              "if",
              "$edit",
              [
                "at",
                "$edit",
                "value"
              ],
              "$base"
            ]
          },
          {
            "let": "ref",
            "value": [
              "concat",
              [
                "if",
                [
                  "eq",
                  "$def.scope",
                  "resource"
                ],
                "#hh-resource-",
                "#hh-param-"
              ],
              "$def.key"
            ]
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.write",
            "args": {
              "ref": "$ref",
              "name": "value",
              "value": "$value"
            },
            "into": "hp156"
          },
          {
            "port": "browser.select",
            "args": {
              "selector": [
                "concat",
                "$ref",
                "-value"
              ]
            },
            "into": "outputs"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "greater",
              "values": [
                "list",
                [
                  "count",
                  "$outputs"
                ],
                0
              ]

          {
            "when": "$hn157",

                    "$ref",

                    "concat",
                    "$value",
                    " ",
                    "$def.unit"

        "yield": null,
        "into": "unused"

    "household.change": [
      {
        "let": "target",
        "value": "$eventInput.matched"
      },
      {
        "let": "id",
        "value": [
          "at",
          "$target.attributes",
          "id"
        ]
      },
      {
        "when": [
          "eq",
          "$id",
          "hh-period-slider"
        ],
        "then": [
          {
            "port": "kernel.invoke",

            },
            "into": "_"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "let": "preset",
        "value": [
          "includes",
          [
            "list",
            "hh-orientation",
            "hh-change",
            "hh-profile",
            "hh-enabled"
          ],
          "$id"
        ]
      },
      {
        "when": "$preset",
        "then": [
          {
            "when": [
              "eq",
              "$id",
              "hh-orientation"
            ],
            "then": [
              {
                "port": "state.set",
                "args": {
                  "key": "hh-orientation",
                  "value": "$target.value"
                },
                "into": "hp159"
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "when": [
              "eq",
              "$id",
              "hh-change"
            ],
            "then": [
              {
                "port": "state.set",
                "args": {
                  "key": "hh-change",
                  "value": "$target.value"
                },
                "into": "hp160"
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "when": [
              "eq",
              "$id",
              "hh-profile"
            ],
            "then": [
              {
                "port": "state.set",
                "args": {
                  "key": "hh-profile",
                  "value": "$target.value"
                },
                "into": "hp161"
              }
            ]

          {
            "when": [
              "eq",

              "hh-enabled"

            "then": [
              {
                "port": "state.set",

                  "key": "hh-enabled",

          {
            "port": "state.set",
            "args": {
              "key": "hh-overrides",
              "value": [
                "list"

          {
            "port": "kernel.invoke",
            "args": {
              "query": "household.rebuild",
              "input": {}
            },
            "into": "hq164"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "when": [
          "includes",
          [
            "list",
            "hh-person",
            "hh-phase",
            "hh-period-slider"
          ],
          "$id"
        ],
        "then": [
          {
            "when": [
              "eq",
              "$id",
              "hh-person"
            ],
            "then": [
              {
                "port": "state.set",
                "args": {
                  "key": "hh-person",
                  "value": "$target.value"
                },
                "into": "hp165"
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "when": [
              "eq",
              "$id",
              "hh-phase"
            ],
            "then": [
              {
                "port": "state.set",
                "args": {
                  "key": "hh-phase",
                  "value": "$target.value"
                },
                "into": "hp166"
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "port": "kernel.invoke",
            "args": {
              "query": "household.sync",
              "input": {}
            },
            "into": "hq167"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "when": [
          "and",
          [
            "not",
            "$preset"
          ],
          [
            "not",
            [
              "includes",
              [
                "list",
                "hh-person",
                "hh-phase",
                "hh-period-slider"
              ],
              "$id"
            ]
          ]
        ],
        "then": [
          {
            "port": "state.get",
            "args": {
              "key": "hh-person"
            },
            "into": "person"
          },
          {
            "port": "state.get",
            "args": {
              "key": "hh-phase"
            },
            "into": "phase"
          },
          {
            "port": "state.get",
            "args": {
              "key": "hh-overrides"
            },
            "into": "overrides"
          },
          {
            "let": "key",
            "value": [
              "at",
              "$target.attributes",
              "data-hh-key"
            ]
          },
          {
            "let": "scope",
            "value": [
              "at",
              "$target.attributes",
              "data-hh-scope"
            ]
          },
          {
            "let": "def",
            "value": [
              "at",
              [
                "filter",
                "$data.household.controls",
                "d",
                [
                  "and",
                  [
                    "eq",
                    "$d.key",
                    "$key"
                  ],
                  [
                    "eq",
                    "$d.scope",
                    "$scope"
                  ]
                ]
              ],
              0
            ]
          },
          {
            "when": "$def",
            "then": [
              {
                "let": "value",
                "value": "$target.value"
              },
              {
                "when": [
                  "not",
                  [
                    "eq",
                    "$key",
                    "handling"
                  ]
                ],
                "then": [
                  {
                    "port": "number.parse",
                    "args": {
                      "value": "$target.value"
                    },
                    "into": "numeric"
                  },
                  {
                    "port": "number.calculate",
                    "args": {
                      "operation": "max",
                      "values": [
                        "list",
                        "$def.min",
                        [
                          "or",
                          "$numeric",
                          0
                        ]
                      ]
                    },
                    "into": "hn169"
                  },
                  {
                    "port": "number.calculate",
                    "args": {
                      "operation": "min",
                      "values": [
                        "list",
                        "$def.max",
                        "$hn169"
                      ]
                    },
                    "into": "hn168"
                  },
                  {
                    "let": "value",
                    "value": "$hn168"
                  }
                ]
              },
              {
                "let": "phaseKey",
                "value": [
                  "if",
                  [
                    "eq",
                    "$scope",
                    "rate"
                  ],
                  "run",
                  [
                    "if",
                    [
                      "eq",
                      "$scope",
                      "resource"
                    ],
                    "initial",
                    "$phase"
                  ]
                ]
              },
              {
                "let": "editId",
                "value": [
                  "concat",
                  "$scope",
                  "-",
                  [
                    "if",
                    [
                      "eq",
                      "$scope",
                      "resource"
                    ],
                    "household",
                    "$person"
                  ],
                  "-",
                  "$phaseKey",
                  "-",
                  "$key"
                ]
              },
              {
                "let": "overrides",
                "value": [
                  "append",
                  [
                    "filter",
                    "$overrides",
                    "e",
                    [
                      "not",
                      [
                        "eq",
                        "$e.id",
                        "$editId"
                      ]
                    ]
                  ],
                  [
                    "list",
                    {
                      "id": "$editId",
                      "scope": "$scope",
                      "person": "$person",
                      "phase": "$phaseKey",
                      "key": "$key",
                      "value": "$value"
                    }
                  ]
                ]
              },
              {
                "port": "state.set",
                "args": {
                  "key": "hh-overrides",
                  "value": "$overrides"
                },
                "into": "hp170"
              },
              {
                "port": "kernel.invoke",
                "args": {
                  "query": "household.rebuild",
                  "input": {}
                },
                "into": "hq171"
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "household.click": [
      {
        "let": "id",
        "value": [
          "at",
          "$eventInput.matched.attributes",
          "id"
        ]
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-period"
        },
        "into": "period"
      },
      {
        "when": [
          "eq",
          "$id",
          "hh-reset"
        ],
        "then": [
          {
            "port": "state.set",
            "args": {
              "key": "hh-overrides",
              "value": [
                "list"
              ]
            },
            "into": "hp172"
          },
          {
            "port": "kernel.invoke",
            "args": {
              "query": "household.rebuild",
              "input": {}
            },
            "into": "hq173"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "when": [
          "includes",
          [
            "list",
            "hh-prev",
            "hh-next"
          ],
          "$id"
        ],
        "then": [
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "add",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$period",
                [
                  "if",
                  [
                    "eq",
                    "$id",
                    "hh-next"
                  ],
                  1,
                  -1
                ]
              ]
            },
            "into": "hn177"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "min",
              "values": [
                "list",
                12,
                "$hn177"
              ]
            },
            "into": "hn176"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "max",
              "values": [
                "list",
                1,
                "$hn176"
              ]
            },
            "into": "hn175"
          },
          {
            "port": "state.set",
            "args": {
              "key": "hh-period",
              "value": "$hn175"
            },
            "into": "hp174"
          },
          {
            "port": "kernel.invoke",
            "args": {
              "query": "household.render",
              "input": {}
            },
            "into": "hq178"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "let": "selected",
        "value": [
          "at",
          "$eventInput.matched.attributes",
          "data-hh-period"
        ]
      },
      {
        "when": "$selected",

          {
            "port": "number.parse",
            "args": {
              "value": "$selected"

            "into": "n"

          {

            "args": {
              "key": "hh-period",

            "into": "hp179"

          {
            "port": "kernel.invoke",
            "args": {
              "query": "household.render",
              "input": {}
            },
            "into": "hq180"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "household.render": [
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-run"
        },
        "into": "run"
      },
      {

                        [
                          "eq",

                "attrs": {},

                "tag": "p",

    "household.gog.plan": [
      {
        "let": "view",

      },
      {
        "assert": [

      {

      },
      {
        "port": "number.calculate",

      {
        "let": "yRange",

          {

            "args": {

            "into": "hn152"

            "into": "hp151"

        "into": "yTicks"
      },
      {
        "fold": "$view.ticks.x",
        "as": "tick",

        "initial": [

          {

            "args": {

    "household.chart.render": [
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-run"
        },
        "into": "run"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-period"
        },
        "into": "period"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.environment",
        "args": {},
        "into": "environment"
      },
      {
        "port": "browser.read",
        "args": {
          "ref": "#hh-timeline"
        },
        "into": "target"
      },
      {
        "port": "number.calculate",
        "args": {
          "operation": "greater",
          "values": [
            "list",
            "$environment.width",
            900
          ]
        },
        "into": "hn176"
      },
      {
        "port": "number.calculate",
        "args": {
          "operation": "subtract",
          "values": [
            "list",
            "$target.rect.width",
            24
          ]
        },
        "into": "hn178"
      },
      {
        "port": "number.calculate",
        "args": {
          "operation": "divide",
          "values": [
            "list",
            "$hn178",
            2
          ]
        },
        "into": "hn177"
      },
      {
        "port": "number.calculate",
        "args": {
          "operation": "floor",
          "values": [
            "list",
            [
              "if",
              "$hn176",
              "$hn177",
              "$target.rect.width"
            ]
          ]
        },
        "into": "hn175"
      },
      {
        "let": "width",
        "value": "$hn175"
      },
      {
        "fold": "$run.history",
        "as": "r",
        "accumulator": "longData",
        "initial": [
          "list"
        ],
        "steps": [],
        "yield": [
          "append",
          "$longData",
          [
            "list",
            {
              "person": "A",
              "period": "$r.period",
              "closing": "$r.willingnessClosing.A",
              "opening": "$r.willingnessOpening.A"
            },
            {
              "person": "B",
              "period": "$r.period",
              "closing": "$r.willingnessClosing.B",
              "opening": "$r.willingnessOpening.B"
            }
          ]
        ],
        "into": "longData"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-overrides"
        },
        "into": "overrides"
      },
      {
        "port": "kernel.invoke",
        "args": {
          "query": "household.chart.changes",
          "input": {
            "history": "$run.history",
            "overrides": "$overrides"
          }
        },
        "into": "changes"
      },
      {
        "port": "kernel.invoke",
        "args": {
          "query": "household.gog.plan",
          "input": {
            "view": "$data.household.chart",
            "data": "$longData",
            "width": "$width",
            "period": "$period",
            "changes": "$changes"
          }
        },
        "into": "plan"
      },
      {
        "fold": "$plan.facets",
        "as": "facet",
        "accumulator": "figures",
        "initial": [
          "list"
        ],
        "steps": [
          {
            "port": "number.format",
            "args": {
              "value": "$facet.selected.closing",
              "digits": 3
            },
            "into": "hp179"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.calculate",
            "args": {
              "operation": "subtract",
              "values": [
                "list",
                "$facet.selected.closing",
                "$facet.selected.opening"
              ]
            },
            "into": "hn180"
          },
          {
            "let": "delta",
            "value": "$hn180"
          },
          {
            "port": "number.format",
            "args": {
              "value": "$delta",
              "digits": 3
            },
            "into": "hp181"
          },
          {
            "fold": "$plan.yTicks",
            "as": "tick",
            "accumulator": "grid",
            "initial": [
              "list"
            ],
            "steps": [
              {
                "port": "number.calculate",
                "args": {
                  "operation": "subtract",
                  "values": [
                    "list",
                    "$plan.frame.width",
                    "$plan.frame.right"
                  ]
                },
                "into": "hn182"
              },
              {
                "port": "number.calculate",
                "args": {
                  "operation": "add",
                  "values": [
                    "list",
                    "$tick.y",
                    4
                  ]
                },
                "into": "hn183"
              }
            ],
            "yield": [
              "append",
              "$grid",
              [
                "list",
                {
                  "tag": "line",
                  "attrs": {
                    "x1": "$plan.frame.left",
                    "x2": "$hn182",
                    "y1": "$tick.y",
                    "y2": "$tick.y",
                    "stroke": "#e1e7e3",
                    "stroke-width": 1
                  },
                  "children": [
                    "list"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "tag": "text",
                  "attrs": {
                    "x": 30,
                    "y": "$hn183",
                    "text-anchor": "end",
                    "fill": "#526255",
                    "font-size": 12
                  },
                  "children": [
                    "list",
                    "$tick.label"
                  ]
                }
              ]
            ],
            "into": "grid"
          },
          {
            "fold": "$plan.xTicks",
            "as": "tick",
            "accumulator": "xticks",
            "initial": [
              "list"
            ],
            "steps": [],
            "yield": [
              "append",
              "$xticks",

    "household.chart.select": [
      {
        "port": "number.parse",
        "args": {
          "value": "$eventInput.matched.value"
        },
        "into": "n"
      },
      {
        "port": "number.calculate",
        "args": {
          "operation": "min",
          "values": [
            "list",
            12,
            "$n"
          ]
        },
        "into": "hn195"
      },
      {
        "port": "number.calculate",
        "args": {
          "operation": "max",
          "values": [
            "list",
            1,
            "$hn195"
          ]
        },
        "into": "hn194"
      },
      {
        "port": "state.set",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-period",
          "value": "$hn194"
        },
        "into": "hp193"
      },
      {
        "port": "kernel.invoke",
        "args": {
          "query": "household.render",
          "input": {}
        },
        "into": "hq196"
      }
    ],
    "household.chart.resize": [
      {
        "port": "state.get",
        "args": {
          "key": "hh-run"
        },
        "into": "ready"
      },
      {
        "when": "$ready",
        "then": [
          {
            "port": "kernel.invoke",
            "args": {
              "query": "household.chart.render",
              "input": {}
            },
            "into": "hq197"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "household.chart.changes": [
      {
        "fold": "$eventInput.history",
        "as": "row",
        "accumulator": "periods",
        "initial": [
          "list"
        ],
        "steps": [
          {
            "let": "preset",
            "value": [
              "not",
              [
                "eq",
                [
                  "add",
                  [
                    "count",
                    "$row.appliedEvents"
                  ],
                  [
                    "count",
                    "$row.appliedExperienceEvents"
                  ]
                ],
                0
              ]
            ]
          },
          {
            "let": "custom",
            "value": [
              "some",
              "$eventInput.overrides",
              "edit",
              [
                "and",
                [
                  "not",
                  [
                    "eq",
                    "$edit.scope",
                    "rate"
                  ]
                ],
                [
                  "includes",
                  [
                    "list",
                    "initial",
                    "after"
                  ],
                  "$edit.phase"
                ],
                [
                  "eq",
                  "$row.period",
                  [
                    "if",
                    [
                      "eq",
                      "$edit.phase",
                      "after"
                    ],
                    5,
                    1
                  ]
                ]
              ]
            ]
          }
        ],
        "yield": [
          "if",
          [
            "or",
            "$preset",
            "$custom"
          ],
          [
            "append",
            "$periods",
            [
              "list",
              "$row.period"
            ]
          ],
          "$periods"
        ],
        "into": "periods"
      },
      {
        "let": "result",
        "value": "$periods"
      }
    ]
  }

      "html": "<div class=\"art-label\"><span>The boundary</span><span>Power / responsibility</span></div><div class=\"lantern-art\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 100 130\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"A lantern casting warm light\"><defs><radialGradient id=\"flame\"><stop stop-color=\"#fff0bf\"/><stop offset=\"1\" stop-color=\"#e87e40\"/></radialGradient></defs><path d=\"M36 26c0-23 28-23 28 0M29 30h42l-7 11v52l9 12H27l9-12V41Z\" stroke=\"#b99175\" stroke-width=\"1.3\" fill=\"none\"/><path d=\"M40 46h20v43H40Z\" fill=\"#e4843922\" stroke=\"#9e704e\"/><path d=\"M50 56c-13 18-6 24 0 24s12-8 0-24\" fill=\"url(#flame)\"/><path d=\"M31 105h38M36 41h28M36 93h28M42 30h16\" stroke=\"#b99175\" stroke-width=\"1.2\"/></svg></div><p class=\"field-quote\">Who is carrying<br>the cost?</p><p class=\"marginal\">ATTENTION · PROTECTION · RESPONSIBILITY</p>",

    },

      "html": "<div class=\"art-label\"><span>The human in the process</span><span>A shared world</span></div><div style=\"__CSS_sourcery_0__\"><div class=\"diagram-card\"><small>PEOPLE KEEP THE PURPOSE</small>Taste · judgment · direction</div><div class=\"diagram-arrow\">↓</div><div class=\"diagram-card\"><small>AI SHARES THE WORK</small>Represent · propose · test</div><div class=\"diagram-arrow\">↓</div><div class=\"diagram-card\"><small>PEOPLE REMAIN ACCOUNTABLE</small>Choose · revise · take responsibility</div></div><p class=\"art-caption\">A representation makes some things explicit.     "monster": {
      "id": "monster",
      "title": "A broad view and a detailed count",
      "html": "<p class=\"encounter-label\">THE CABINET / CHANGE THE DETECTOR</p><div class=\"cabinet\"><div class=\"specimen\"><span>E₈³</span><span>LEECH</span><span>MOONSHINE</span></div><div class=\"specimen-values\" id=\"specimen-values\"><strong>≈</strong><strong>≈</strong><strong>≈</strong></div><p id=\"cabinet-caption\" aria-live=\"polite\">These three mathematical structures look alike in the broad measurement.</p><div class=\"art-controls\"><button class=\"control\" data-encounter=\"cabinet\" data-view=\"thermal\" aria-pressed=\"true\">Broad measurement</button><button class=\"control\" data-encounter=\"cabinet\" data-view=\"currents\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Detailed count</button></div><div class=\"cabinet-rays\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div></div><p class=\"demo-note\">DECLARED CANDIDATE FAMILY · NOT PHYSICAL IDENTIFICATION</p>",
      "instruction": "Compare the broad view with the detailed count. Which view tells the three structures apart?",
      "note": "A mathematical comparison of these three structures.",
      "type": "monster"
    },
    "calibration": {
      "id": "calibration",
      "title": "Turn the measuring line",
      "html": "<p class=\"encounter-label\">THE LENS BENCH / TRY A DIFFERENT AXIS</p><div class=\"lens-bench\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 400 340\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"An illustrative axis rotates toward a hidden difference\"><defs><radialGradient id=\"lensLight\"><stop stop-color=\"#78d8ff\" stop-opacity=\".22\"/><stop offset=\"1\" stop-color=\"#78d8ff\" stop-opacity=\"0\"/></radialGradient></defs><circle cx=\"200\" cy=\"165\" r=\"145\" fill=\"url(#lensLight)\"/><g class=\"bench-grid\"><circle cx=\"200\" cy=\"165\" r=\"110\"/><circle cx=\"200\" cy=\"165\" r=\"70\"/><path d=\"M40 165h320M200 15v300\"/></g><g id=\"lens-axis\" transform=\"rotate(0 200 165)\"><path d=\"M65 165h270\" class=\"axis-light\"/><path d=\"m325 159 10 6-10 6\" class=\"axis-light\"/></g><circle cx=\"200\" cy=\"165\" r=\"5\" class=\"origin\"/><circle cx=\"200\" cy=\"55\" r=\"6\" class=\"difference\"/><text x=\"217\" y=\"53\" class=\"bench-text\">HIDDEN DIFFERENCE</text></svg><label class=\"range-label\" for=\"lens-angle\">Turn the measuring line <output id=\"angle-value\">0°</output></label><input id=\"lens-angle\" type=\"range\" min=\"0\" max=\"90\" value=\"0\" step=\"1\"><div class=\"bench-reading\"><span>DIFFERENCE THIS VIEW SHOWS</span><output id=\"lens-value\">0.00</output></div><p id=\"lens-caption\" class=\"readout\" aria-live=\"polite\">At this angle, two different points share one reading.</p></div><p class=\"demo-note\">A UNIT-VECTOR ILLUSTRATION · NOT THE FOUR-MODE EXPERIMENT</p>",
      "instruction": "Move the slider. Watch how turning the measuring line changes the number.",
      "note": "A small mathematical example, separate from the larger research experiment.",
      "type": "calibration"
    },
    "replay": {
      "id": "replay",
      "title": "The replay room",
      "html": "<div class=\"art-label\"><span>A question to work with</span><span>Field 11</span></div><div class=\"field-study\"><div class=\"study-step\"><span class=\"study-number\">01</span><small>KEEP</small><p>Save the settings and method</p></div><div class=\"study-step\"><span class=\"study-number\">02</span><small>COMPARE</small><p>Try the journey, its reverse, and no journey</p></div><div class=\"study-step\"><span class=\"study-number\">03</span><small>CHECK</small><p>Run the checks on the saved record</p></div></div><p class=\"art-caption\">A reading of the source. Choose “Where this comes from” to read about its source and limits.</p>",
      "instruction": "",
      "note": "",
      "type": "replay"
    },
    "water": {
      "id": "water",
      "title": "The water’s edge",
      "html": "<p class=\"encounter-label\">THE WATER’S EDGE / A PLACE TO LINGER</p><div class=\"quiet-landscape\" data-quiet=\"water\"><div class=\"quiet-moon\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div><div class=\"quiet-hills\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div><div class=\"quiet-water\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><svg class=\"quiet-horse\" viewBox=\"0 0 180 180\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><path d=\"m45 165 9-64 22-34 1-34 21 28 24-7 24 21 20 29-11 17-30-13-9 57\"/><circle cx=\"132\" cy=\"83\" r=\"2\"/></svg><p class=\"quiet-words\" id=\"quiet-words\" aria-live=\"polite\">Even the guide has a reflection.</p><button class=\"quiet-button\" data-encounter=\"quiet\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Look into the water</button></div><p class=\"art-caption\">A small fable. No horse was consulted.</p>",
      "instruction": "",
      "note": "",
      "type": "water"
    },
    "discomfort": {
      "id": "discomfort",
      "title": "The inconvenient truth",
      "html": "<div class=\"art-label\"><span>A question to work with</span><span>Field 13</span></div><div class=\"field-study\"><div class=\"study-step\"><span class=\"study-number\">01</span><small>NOTICE</small><p>Something does not fit</p></div><div class=\"study-step\"><span class=\"study-number\">02</span><small>SEPARATE</small><p>What happened? What did I think it meant?</p></div><div class=\"study-step\"><span class=\"study-number\">03</span><small>CHECK</small><p>What could tell the explanations apart?</p></div></div><p class=\"art-caption\">A reading of the source. Choose “Where this comes from” to read about its source and limits.</p>",
      "instruction": "",
      "note": "",
      "type": "discomfort"
    },
    "listening": {
      "id": "listening",
      "title": "Try a conversation",
      "html": "<p class=\"encounter-label\">A SMALL CONVERSATION / CHOOSE A RESPONSE</p><div class=\"conversation\"><div class=\"speaker-orbit\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span></span><i></i></div><p class=\"conversation-line\">“I know the plan makes sense. I’m not sure I can keep doing it.”</p><div class=\"reply-options\"><button data-encounter=\"reply\" data-reply=\"0\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Offer a more efficient plan<span aria-hidden=\"true\">↳</span></button><button data-encounter=\"reply\" data-reply=\"1\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Ask what has become difficult<span aria-hidden=\"true\">↳</span></button><button data-encounter=\"reply\" data-reply=\"2\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Ask what they need from this conversation<span aria-hidden=\"true\">↳</span></button></div><div id=\"conversation-answer\" aria-live=\"polite\"><p class=\"encounter-hint\">Try a response. You can take the conversation another way.</p></div></div><p class=\"demo-note\">FICTIONAL DIALOGUE · NO SCORE · NO ANSWER SAVED</p>",
      "instruction": "Choose a reply, then read the possible response. You can try every reply.",
      "note": "A fictional conversation. No score is given and no reply is saved.",
      "type": "listening"
    },
    "restraint": {
      "id": "restraint",
      "title": "The open hand",
      "html": "<div class=\"art-label\"><span>The boundary</span><span>Power / responsibility</span></div><div class=\"lantern-art\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 100 130\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"A lantern casting warm light\"><defs><radialGradient id=\"flame\"><stop stop-color=\"#fff0bf\"/><stop offset=\"1\" stop-color=\"#e87e40\"/></radialGradient></defs><path d=\"M36 26c0-23 28-23 28 0M29 30h42l-7 11v52l9 12H27l9-12V41Z\" stroke=\"#b99175\" stroke-width=\"1.3\" fill=\"none\"/><path d=\"M40 46h20v43H40Z\" fill=\"#e4843922\" stroke=\"#9e704e\"/><path d=\"M50 56c-13 18-6 24 0 24s12-8 0-24\" fill=\"url(#flame)\"/><path d=\"M31 105h38M36 41h28M36 93h28M42 30h16\" stroke=\"#b99175\" stroke-width=\"1.2\"/></svg></div><p class=\"field-quote\">Who is carrying<br>the cost?</p><p class=\"marginal\">ATTENTION · PROTECTION · RESPONSIBILITY</p>",
      "instruction": "",
      "note": "",
      "type": "restraint"
    },
    "permission": {
      "id": "permission",
      "title": "Three questions before acting",
      "html": "<p class=\"encounter-label\">THREE DOORS / AN ORDINARY DECISION</p><p class=\"decision-premise\">A capable assistant has drafted a message that would change someone’s plans.</p><div class=\"decision-doors\"><button class=\"decision-door\" data-encounter=\"door\" data-door=\"can\" aria-pressed=\"false\"><span>01</span><strong>I can</strong><small>The message is ready.</small></button><button class=\"decision-door\" data-encounter=\"door\" data-door=\"may\" aria-pressed=\"false\"><span>02</span><strong>May I?</strong><small>Who gets to authorize it?</small></button><button class=\"decision-door\" data-encounter=\"door\" data-door=\"should\" aria-pressed=\"false\"><span>03</span><strong>Should I?</strong><small>What does the situation call for?</small></button></div><div class=\"door-answer\" id=\"door-answer\" aria-live=\"polite\">Open a door. Each answers a different question.</div><p class=\"demo-note\">A FICTIONAL DECISION · THESE DOORS SEND NOTHING</p>",
      "instruction": "Open each door. Each asks a different question about the same proposed action.",
      "note": "A fictional decision. No message is sent.",
      "type": "permission"
    },
    "representation": {
      "id": "representation",
      "title": "Look beneath the map",
      "html": "<p class=\"encounter-label\">AN OBJECT WITH LAYERS / LIFT THE SURFACE</p><div class=\"map-object\"><div class=\"map-sheet sheet-back\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div><div class=\"map-sheet sheet-middle\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div><div class=\"map-sheet sheet-front\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><span>THE MAP<br>IS A VIEW.</span></div></div><div class=\"object-controls\"><button class=\"control\" data-encounter=\"layer\" data-layer=\"surface\" aria-pressed=\"true\">What it shows</button><button class=\"control\" data-encounter=\"layer\" data-layer=\"conditions\" aria-pressed=\"false\">What it assumes</button><button class=\"control\" data-encounter=\"layer\" data-layer=\"limits\" aria-pressed=\"false\">What it cannot prove</button></div><div class=\"layer-notes\" aria-live=\"polite\"><p><span>RECORD</span>A story based on a source.</p><p id=\"layer-conditions\" hidden><span>CONDITIONS</span>Its meaning depends on its definitions, starting assumptions and source.</p><p id=\"layer-limits\" hidden><span>LIMITS</span>A written plan for an experiment does not prove that it was carried out.</p></div>",
      "instruction": "Open each layer to see what the map needs you to know.",
      "note": "",
      "type": "representation"
    },
    "revision": {
      "id": "revision",
      "title": "See why an explanation changed",
      "html": "<p class=\"encounter-label\">THE VISIBLE SEAM / COMPARE TWO READINGS</p><div class=\"revision-object\"><p class=\"seam-before\">An elegant framework<br>for the new question.</p><span class=\"seam-line\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></span><button class=\"control\" data-encounter=\"revision\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"revision-after\">Open the correction</button><div id=\"revision-after\" hidden><p class=\"seam-after\">The framework came<br>from another inquiry.</p><p class=\"art-caption\">The interpretation was withdrawn. The next inquiry began with the mismatch.</p><button class=\"source-button\" data-source=\"correction\">Read the retained correction ↗</button></div></div>",
      "instruction": "Open the correction to see why the earlier explanation was withdrawn.",
      "note": "",
      "type": "revision"
    },
